prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1176; do not mention it.)
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain radiating into the right buttock, with muscle spasm and reduced lumbar range of motion. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no focal motor or sensory deficits and symmetric reflexes. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag symptoms. Treatment over the course of seven visits consisted of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, a graded therapeutic exercise program focused on core stabilization and lumbar mobility, and instruction in posture and activity modification. Home exercise compliance was good. Pain intensity decreased steadily across visits, and by the final visit the patient reported mild intermittent discomfort with improved range of motion and return to most daily activities. Residual stiffness with prolonged sitting persists, and ergonomic recommendations were provided. The patient was discharged to a self-directed home program with instructions to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
